name: "Currywurst" Sausage Wrap with Red Cabbage, Bell Pepper & Apple Slaw

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ lemons
1 ½ small heads red cabbage
3 Granny Smith apples
3 yellow bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Once the pan is hot, coat with oil; add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until cooked through, 12-15 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
6 pork sausages

instructions.primary_message: While the sausages are cooking, place ketchup, water, Worcestershire, vinegar, and spices in a small bowl. Whisk to combine the sauce and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup ketchup
3 tbsp water
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp paprika
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch cayenne pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice lemons into a large bowl; add yogurt, mayo, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
¾ tsp garlic powder
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Quarter each cabbage lengthwise, then cut out and discard the core; slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and small dice apples; add to the bowl.
Trim, halve, seed, and slice bell peppers into thin strips; add to the bowl and toss to combine the slaw. Set aside.
When the sausages are done, transfer to a cutting board and slice crosswise into thin rounds.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Place tortillas on a flat surface and top each with a small portion of slaw; arrange sausage slices on top and drizzle with sauce. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining slaw for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates; serve with remaining slaw on the side. Enjoy!
